+            quantity=D(quantity),
+            order_type="LIMIT",
+            client_order_id=client_order_id,
+            symbol=symbol,
+        )
+
+    def _order(
+        self,
+        order_id: str,
+        *,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        order_type: str,
+        status: str = "ACCEPTED",
+        filled_quantity: Decimal = ZERO,
+        stop_price: Decimal | None = None,
+        client_order_id: str | None = None,
+        symbol: str = "AAPL",
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        return {
+            "broker_order_id": order_id,
+            "client_order_id": client_order_id or f"client-{order_id}",
+            "position_id": "position-1",
+            "symbol": symbol,
+            "side": "SELL",
+            "order_type": order_type,
+            "status": status,
+            "quantity": quantity,
+            "filled_quantity": filled_quantity,
+            "stop_price": stop_price,
+        }
+
+    async def confirmed_position_quantity(self, position_id: str, symbol: str) -> Decimal:
+        assert symbol == "AAPL"
+        return self.positions.get(position_id, D("0"))
+
+    async def list_open_orders(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        return list(self.orders.values())
+
+    async def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        self.calls.append(("cancel", order_id))
+        scripted = self.cancel_scripts.get(order_id)
+        if scripted is not None:
+            result = scripted()
+            if asyncio.iscoroutine(result):
+                return await result
+            return result
+        order = self.orders[order_id]
+        order["status"] = "CANCELED"
+        return dict(order)
+
+    async def get_order(self, order_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        order = self.orders.get(order_id)
+        return None if order is None else dict(order)
+
+    async def submit_exit(self, intent: SellIntent, quantity: Decimal) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        self.calls.append(("exit", quantity))
+        self.sequence += 1
+        order_id = f"exit-{self.sequence}"
+        fill = self.next_exit_fill
+        if self.next_exit_status == "FILLED":
+            fill = quantity
+        if fill:
+            assert fill <= self.positions[intent.position_id], "fake broker would go short"
+            self.positions[intent.position_id] -= fill
+        order = self._order(
+            order_id,
+            quantity=quantity,
+            order_type=str(intent.order_type),
+            status=self.next_exit_status,
+            filled_quantity=fill,
+            client_order_id=intent.client_order_id,
+        )
+        self.orders[order_id] = order
+        return dict(order)
+
+    async def submit_protective_stop(
+        self,
+        position_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        stop_price: Decimal,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        self.calls.append(("protect", quantity))
+        if self.fail_protection:
+            raise RuntimeError("scripted protection failure")
+        assert quantity <= self.positions[position_id]
+        self.sequence += 1
+        order_id = f"stop-reprotected-{self.sequence}"
+        order = self._order(
+            order_id,
+            quantity=quantity,
+            order_type="STOP",
+            stop_price=stop_price,
+            client_order_id=client_order_id,
+            symbol=symbol,
+        )
+        self.orders[order_id] = order
+        return dict(order)
+
+    async def replace_protective_stop(
+        self,
+        order_id: str,
+        position_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        stop_price: Decimal,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        self.calls.append(("replace-start", order_id))
+        if self.replace_started is not None:
+            self.replace_started.set()
+        if self.replace_release is not None:
+            await self.replace_release.wait()
+        self.orders[order_id]["status"] = "REPLACED"
+        self.sequence += 1
+        new_id = f"stop-replaced-{self.sequence}"
+        order = self._order(
+            new_id,
+            quantity=quantity,
+            order_type="STOP",
+            stop_price=stop_price,
+            client_order_id=client_order_id,
+            symbol=symbol,
+        )
+        self.orders[new_id] = order
+        self.calls.append(("replace-done", new_id))
+        return dict(order)
+
+    def fill_stop_during_cancel(self, quantity: Decimal) -> Callable[[], dict[str, Any]]:
+        def apply() -> dict[str, Any]:
+            order = self.orders["stop-1"]
+            assert quantity <= self.positions["position-1"]
+            self.positions["position-1"] -= quantity
+            order["filled_quantity"] += quantity
+            order["status"] = (
+                "FILLED" if order["filled_quantity"] == order["quantity"] else "CANCELED"
+            )
+            return dict(order)
+
+        return apply
+
+
+def coordinator(broker: FakeBroker) -> tuple[CloseCoordinator, Events]:
+    events = Events()
+    value = CloseCoordinator(broker, Clock(), events)
+    value.register_protective_stop(
+        position_id="position-1", symbol="AAPL", order_id="stop-1", stop_price=D("95")
+    )
+    return value, events
+
+
+def intent(
+    kind: str = "STRATEGY",
+    *,
+    quantity: str = "10",
+    minimum_hold: timedelta = timedelta(0),
+    filled_at: datetime | None = NOW - timedelta(days=1),
+) -> SellIntent:
+    return SellIntent(
+        position_id="position-1",
+        symbol="AAPL",
+        quantity=D(quantity),
+        kind=kind,
+        client_order_id=f"exit-{kind.lower()}",
+        first_confirmed_entry_fill_at=filled_at,
+        minimum_hold=minimum_hold,
+    )
+

+async def test_discretionary_exit_waits_for_broker_confirmed_stop_cancel() -> None:
+    broker = FakeBroker()
+    broker.add_stop()
+    cancel_started = asyncio.Event()
+    release_cancel = asyncio.Event()
+
+    async def delayed_cancel() -> dict[str, Any]:
+        cancel_started.set()
+        await release_cancel.wait()
+        broker.orders["stop-1"]["status"] = "CANCELED"
+        return dict(broker.orders["stop-1"])
+
+    broker.cancel_scripts["stop-1"] = delayed_cancel
+    close, _ = coordinator(broker)
+    task = asyncio.create_task(close.close(intent()))
+    await cancel_started.wait()
+    assert not any(call[0] == "exit" for call in broker.calls)
+    release_cancel.set()
+    outcome = await task
+    assert outcome.status == "SUBMITTED"
+    assert [call[0] for call in broker.calls] == ["cancel", "exit"]

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+async def test_unknown_cancel_freezes_conflicts_and_blocks_entries() -> None:
+    broker = FakeBroker()
+    broker.add_stop()
+
+    def unknown() -> dict[str, Any]:
+        broker.orders["stop-1"]["status"] = "UNKNOWN"

+
+    broker.cancel_scripts["stop-1"] = unknown

+    second = await close.close(intent("MANUAL_CLOSE"))

+async def test_manual_close_serializes_behind_pending_trailing_replacement() -> None:
+    broker = FakeBroker()
+    broker.add_stop()
+    broker.replace_started = asyncio.Event()
+    broker.replace_release = asyncio.Event()
+    close, _ = coordinator(broker)
+    replacement = asyncio.create_task(
+        close.replace_protective_stop(
+            position_id="position-1",
+            symbol="AAPL",
+            order_id="stop-1",
+            stop_price=D("97"),
+            client_order_id="replace-1",
+        )

+    broker.replace_release.set()

+    assert (await manual).status == "SUBMITTED"

+"""Race-safe coordination of long-position sell intents.
+
+The coordinator is deliberately a small orchestration boundary.  It owns no
+broker connection and no durable store: the broker order port, clock, and event
+sink are injected.  Broker observations are authoritative for both position
+quantity and order state.
+
+All mutations for one ``position_id`` run under the same asynchronous lock.
+In particular, a discretionary close cannot pass a trailing-stop replacement,
+and an exit order is never sent until removal of the previous protective stop
+has been confirmed by the broker.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import inspect
+from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Protocol
+
+__all__ = [
+    "CloseCoordinator",
+    "SellIntent",
+    "CloseOutcome",
+    "OrphanOrder",
+    "detect_orphan_orders",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_TERMINAL = frozenset({"FILLED", "CANCELED", "CANCELLED", "EXPIRED", "REJECTED", "REPLACED"})
+_WORKING = frozenset(
+    {
+        "NEW",
+        "PENDING_NEW",
+        "ACCEPTED",
+        "PENDING",
+        "PARTIALLY_FILLED",
+        "PENDING_CANCEL",
+        "CANCEL_PENDING",
+        "SUSPENDED",
+    }
+)
+_STOP_TYPES = frozenset({"STOP", "STOP_LIMIT", "TRAILING_STOP"})
+_STRATEGY_KINDS = frozenset({"STRATEGY", "STRATEGY_EXIT", "EXIT_LONG"})
+_MANUAL_KINDS = frozenset({"MANUAL", "MANUAL_CLOSE", "CLOSE_ALL", "FLATTEN"})
+_SAFETY_KINDS = frozenset(
+    {"SAFETY", "SAFETY_EXIT", "RISK_SAFETY", "DAILY_LOSS", "RECONCILIATION", "END_OF_DAY"}
+)
+
+
+class _Clock(Protocol):
+    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+class _CloseOrderPort(Protocol):
+    """Minimal async broker surface used by :class:`CloseCoordinator`.
+
+    A port may return domain objects or mappings.  Status, quantity, and ID
+    fields use the normal normalized names (``status``, ``quantity``/``qty``,
+    ``filled_quantity``/``filled_qty``, and ``broker_order_id``/``order_id``).
+    """
+
+    def confirmed_position_quantity(
+        self, position_id: str, symbol: str
+    ) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def list_open_orders(self) -> Sequence[object] | Awaitable[Sequence[object]]: ...
+
+    def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> object | Awaitable[object]: ...
+
+    def get_order(self, order_id: str) -> object | None | Awaitable[object | None]: ...
+
+    def submit_exit(self, intent: SellIntent, quantity: Decimal) -> object | Awaitable[object]: ...
+
+    def submit_protective_stop(
+        self,
+        position_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        stop_price: Decimal,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> object | Awaitable[object]: ...
+
+    def replace_protective_stop(
+        self,
+        order_id: str,
+        position_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        quantity: Decimal,
+        stop_price: Decimal,
+        client_order_id: str,
+    ) -> object | Awaitable[object]: ...
+
+
+def _text(value: object, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _symbol(value: object) -> str:
+    result = _text(value, "symbol").upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
+        raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+    return result
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value < _ZERO or (positive and value == _ZERO):
+        operator = "> 0" if positive else ">= 0"
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and {operator}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _utc(value: object, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _enum_text(value: object | None) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    return "" if raw is None else str(raw).strip().upper()
+
+
+def _field(item: object, *names: str, default: object = None) -> object:
+    if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+        for name in names:
+            if name in item:
+                return item[name]
+        return default
+    for name in names:
+        if hasattr(item, name):
+            return getattr(item, name)
+    return default
+
+
+async def _resolve[T](value: T | Awaitable[T]) -> T:
+    if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+        return await value
+    return value
+
+
+def _status(order: object | None) -> str:
+    return _enum_text(_field(order, "status"))
+
+
+def _order_id(order: object | None) -> str | None:
+    value = _field(order, "broker_order_id", "order_id", "id")
+    return value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() else None
+
+
+def _client_order_id(order: object | None) -> str | None:
+    value = _field(order, "client_order_id", "intent_id")
+    return value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() else None
+
+
+def _quantity(order: object, *names: str) -> Decimal:
+    value = _field(order, *names, default=_ZERO)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        value = Decimal(value)
+    return _decimal(value, names[0])
+
+
+def _is_working(order: object) -> bool:
+    status = _status(order)
+    return status in _WORKING or (bool(status) and status not in _TERMINAL and status != "UNKNOWN")
+
+
+def _remaining(order: object) -> Decimal:
+    total = _quantity(order, "quantity", "qty")
+    filled = _quantity(order, "filled_quantity", "filled_qty")
+    return max(_ZERO, total - filled)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SellIntent:
+    """One requested long-position sale.
+
+    ``quantity`` is validated against the broker position before cancellation.
+    If the protective stop fills during cancellation, the submitted amount is
+    capped to the newly confirmed residual.  Only ``STRATEGY`` kinds observe
+    ``minimum_hold``; every manual and safety kind bypasses it.
+    """
+
+    position_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    quantity: Decimal
+    kind: str | Enum
+    client_order_id: str
+    order_type: str | Enum = "MARKET"
+    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
+    first_confirmed_entry_fill_at: datetime | None = None
+    minimum_hold: timedelta = timedelta(0)
+    protective_order_id: str | None = None
+    last_confirmed_stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "position_id", _text(self.position_id, "position_id"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _symbol(self.symbol))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "quantity", _decimal(self.quantity, "quantity", positive=True))
+        kind = _enum_text(self.kind)
+        if kind not in _STRATEGY_KINDS | _MANUAL_KINDS | _SAFETY_KINDS:
+            raise ValueError("kind must be a strategy, manual, or safety exit")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "kind", kind)
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "client_order_id", _text(self.client_order_id, "client_order_id")
+        )
+        order_type = _enum_text(self.order_type)
+        if order_type not in {"MARKET", "LIMIT"}:
+            raise ValueError("exit order_type must be MARKET or LIMIT")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "order_type", order_type)
+        if order_type == "LIMIT":
+            if self.limit_price is None:
+                raise ValueError("LIMIT exit requires limit_price")
+            _decimal(self.limit_price, "limit_price", positive=True)
+        elif self.limit_price is not None:
+            raise ValueError("MARKET exit must not specify limit_price")
+        if self.first_confirmed_entry_fill_at is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "first_confirmed_entry_fill_at",
+                _utc(self.first_confirmed_entry_fill_at, "first_confirmed_entry_fill_at"),
+            )
+        if not isinstance(self.minimum_hold, timedelta) or self.minimum_hold < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("minimum_hold must be a non-negative timedelta")
+        if self.protective_order_id is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "protective_order_id",
+                _text(self.protective_order_id, "protective_order_id"),
+            )
+        if self.last_confirmed_stop_price is not None:
+            _decimal(self.last_confirmed_stop_price, "last_confirmed_stop_price", positive=True)
+
+    @property
+    def is_strategy(self) -> bool:
+        return str(self.kind) in _STRATEGY_KINDS
+
+    @property
+    def bypasses_entry_gates(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.is_strategy
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CloseOutcome:
+    status: str
+    position_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    submitted_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
+    confirmed_remaining_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None
+    protective_order_id: str | None = None
+    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    reconciliation_required: bool = False
+    entries_blocked: bool = False
+    detail: str = ""
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "status", _text(self.status, "status").upper())
+        object.__setattr__(self, "position_id", _text(self.position_id, "position_id"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _symbol(self.symbol))
+        _decimal(self.submitted_quantity, "submitted_quantity")
+        if self.confirmed_remaining_quantity is not None:
+            _decimal(self.confirmed_remaining_quantity, "confirmed_remaining_quantity")
+        for name in ("broker_order_id", "protective_order_id"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if value is not None:
+                object.__setattr__(self, name, _text(value, name))
+        if self.stop_price is not None:
+            _decimal(self.stop_price, "stop_price", positive=True)
+
+    @property
+    def flat(self) -> bool:
+        return self.confirmed_remaining_quantity == _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def submitted(self) -> bool:
+        return self.submitted_quantity > _ZERO
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OrphanOrder:
+    """An open broker-side sell that is not safe to adopt or ignore."""
+
+    broker_order_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    order_type: str
+    reason: str
+    client_order_id: str | None = None
+    position_quantity: Decimal = _ZERO
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "broker_order_id", _text(self.broker_order_id, "broker_order_id")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _symbol(self.symbol))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "order_type", _text(self.order_type, "order_type").upper())
+        object.__setattr__(self, "reason", _text(self.reason, "reason").upper())
+        if self.client_order_id is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, "client_order_id", _text(self.client_order_id, "client_order_id")
+            )
+        _decimal(self.position_quantity, "position_quantity")
+
+    @property
+    def drift_type(self) -> str:
+        return self.reason
+
+
+def _known_intent_ids(local_intents: Iterable[object]) -> tuple[set[str], set[str]]:
+    broker_ids: set[str] = set()
+    client_ids: set[str] = set()
+    for intent in local_intents:
+        if isinstance(intent, str) and intent.strip():
+            client_ids.add(intent.strip())
+            continue
+        broker_id = _order_id(intent)
+        client_id = _client_order_id(intent)
+        if broker_id is not None:
+            broker_ids.add(broker_id)
+        if client_id is not None:
+            client_ids.add(client_id)
+    return broker_ids, client_ids
+
+
+def _position_quantities(
+    local_positions: Iterable[object] | Mapping[str, object],
+) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
+    result: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
+    values: Iterable[object]
+    if isinstance(local_positions, Mapping):
+        values = tuple(local_positions.items())
+    else:
+        values = local_positions
+    for position in values:
+        if isinstance(position, tuple) and len(position) == 2:
+            symbol, raw_position = position
+            raw_quantity = (
+                raw_position
+                if isinstance(raw_position, (Decimal, str))
+                else _field(
+                    raw_position,
+                    "quantity",
+                    "qty",
+                    "remaining_quantity",
+                    default=_ZERO,
+                )
+            )
+        else:
+            symbol = _field(position, "symbol")
+            raw_quantity = _field(position, "quantity", "qty", "remaining_quantity", default=_ZERO)
+        if not isinstance(symbol, str):
+            continue
+        if isinstance(raw_quantity, str):
+            raw_quantity = Decimal(raw_quantity)
+        if isinstance(raw_quantity, Decimal) and raw_quantity.is_finite():
+            result[_symbol(symbol)] = max(_ZERO, raw_quantity)
+    return result
+
+
+def detect_orphan_orders(
+    broker_open_orders: Iterable[object],
+    local_intents: Iterable[object],
+    local_positions: Iterable[object] | Mapping[str, object],
+) -> tuple[OrphanOrder, ...]:
+    """Return explicit drift records without canceling or adopting any order."""
+
+    broker_ids, client_ids = _known_intent_ids(local_intents)
+    positions = _position_quantities(local_positions)
+    found: list[OrphanOrder] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for order in broker_open_orders:
+        if not _is_working(order):
+            continue
+        side = _enum_text(_field(order, "side"))
+        order_type = _enum_text(_field(order, "order_type", "type"))
+        if side != "SELL" and order_type not in _STOP_TYPES:
+            continue
+        broker_id = _order_id(order)
+        symbol_value = _field(order, "symbol")
+        if broker_id is None or not isinstance(symbol_value, str) or broker_id in seen:
+            continue
+        symbol = _symbol(symbol_value)
+        client_id = _client_order_id(order)
+        quantity = positions.get(symbol, _ZERO)
+        known = broker_id in broker_ids or (client_id is not None and client_id in client_ids)
+        reason: str | None = None
+        if order_type in _STOP_TYPES and quantity == _ZERO:
+            reason = "ORPHAN_STOP_FLAT_POSITION"
+        elif not known:
+            reason = "ORPHAN_SELL_NO_LOCAL_INTENT"
+        elif quantity == _ZERO:
+            reason = "ORPHAN_SELL_NO_POSITION"
+        if reason is not None:
+            seen.add(broker_id)
+            found.append(
+                OrphanOrder(
+                    broker_order_id=broker_id,
+                    client_order_id=client_id,
+                    symbol=symbol,
+                    order_type=order_type or "UNKNOWN",
+                    reason=reason,
+                    position_quantity=quantity,
+                )
+            )
+    return tuple(found)
+
+
+@dataclass(slots=True)
+class _Protection:
+    symbol: str
+    order_id: str | None = None
+    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+
+
+class CloseCoordinator:
+    """Serialize every sell-side mutation for each managed long position."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        broker: _CloseOrderPort,
+        clock: Callable[[], datetime] | _Clock,
+        event_sink: Callable[[Mapping[str, object]], object] | object,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not callable(clock) and not callable(getattr(clock, "now", None)):
+            raise TypeError("clock must be callable or expose now()")
+        if not callable(event_sink) and not callable(getattr(event_sink, "emit", None)):
+            raise TypeError("event_sink must be callable or expose emit()")
+        self._broker = broker
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._event_sink = event_sink
+        self._locks: dict[str, asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._protections: dict[str, _Protection] = {}
+        self._frozen: set[str] = set()
+        self._last_quantities: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
+        self._closed = False
+
+    def register_protective_stop(
+        self,
+        *,
+        position_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        order_id: str,
+        stop_price: Decimal,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Register local intent linkage; this never adopts a broker orphan."""
+
+        key = _text(position_id, "position_id")
+        self._protections[key] = _Protection(
+            _symbol(symbol),
+            _text(order_id, "order_id"),
+            _decimal(stop_price, "stop_price", positive=True),
+        )
+
+    def last_confirmed_quantity(self, position_id: str) -> Decimal | None:
+        return self._last_quantities.get(_text(position_id, "position_id"))
+
+    def is_frozen(self, position_id: str) -> bool:
+        return _text(position_id, "position_id") in self._frozen
+
+    async def close(self, intent: SellIntent) -> CloseOutcome:
+        if not isinstance(intent, SellIntent):
+            raise TypeError("intent must be SellIntent")
+        if self._closed:
+            return self._outcome("REJECTED", intent, detail="coordinator is shut down")
+        async with self._lock(intent.position_id):
+            return await self._close_locked(intent)
+
+    execute = close
+    submit = close
+
+    async def replace_protective_stop(
+        self,
+        *,
+        position_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        order_id: str,
+        stop_price: Decimal,
+        client_order_id: str,
+        quantity: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> CloseOutcome:
+        key = _text(position_id, "position_id")
+        normalized_symbol = _symbol(symbol)
+        old_order_id = _text(order_id, "order_id")
+        candidate = _decimal(stop_price, "stop_price", positive=True)
+        client_id = _text(client_order_id, "client_order_id")
+        if quantity is not None:
+            _decimal(quantity, "quantity", positive=True)
+        if self._closed:
+            return CloseOutcome(
+                "REJECTED", key, normalized_symbol, detail="coordinator is shut down"
+            )
+        async with self._lock(key):
+            if key in self._frozen:
+                return CloseOutcome(
+                    "FROZEN",
+                    key,
+                    normalized_symbol,
+                    reconciliation_required=True,
+                    entries_blocked=True,
+                    detail="position has an unresolved order outcome",
+                )
+            confirmed = await self._confirmed_quantity(key, normalized_symbol)
+            requested = confirmed if quantity is None else quantity
+            committed = await self._working_sell_quantity(
+                key, normalized_symbol, exclude={old_order_id}
+            )
+            if requested > max(_ZERO, confirmed - committed):
+                return CloseOutcome(
+                    "REJECTED",
+                    key,
+                    normalized_symbol,
+                    confirmed_remaining_quantity=confirmed,
+                    detail="protective quantity exceeds broker-confirmed available quantity",
+                )
+            if confirmed == _ZERO:
+                self._protections.pop(key, None)
+                return CloseOutcome(
+                    "FLAT", key, normalized_symbol, confirmed_remaining_quantity=_ZERO
+                )
+            current = self._protections.get(key)
+            if (
+                current is not None
+                and current.stop_price is not None
+                and candidate < current.stop_price
+            ):
+                return CloseOutcome(
+                    "REJECTED",
+                    key,
+                    normalized_symbol,
+                    confirmed_remaining_quantity=confirmed,
+                    protective_order_id=old_order_id,
+                    stop_price=current.stop_price,
+                    detail="protective stop replacement may not lower the last confirmed stop",
+                )
+            try:
+                raw = await _resolve(
+                    self._broker.replace_protective_stop(
+                        old_order_id,
+                        key,
+                        normalized_symbol,
+                        min(requested, confirmed - committed),
+                        candidate,
+                        client_id,
+                    )
+                )
+            except Exception as exc:
+                return await self._freeze(
+                    key,
+                    normalized_symbol,
+                    f"protective replacement outcome unknown: {type(exc).__name__}",
+                )
+            status = _status(raw)
+            if status == "UNKNOWN" or not status:
+                return await self._freeze(
+                    key, normalized_symbol, "protective replacement is UNKNOWN"
+                )
+            remaining = await self._confirmed_quantity(key, normalized_symbol)
+            if status == "FILLED" or remaining == _ZERO:
+                self._protections.pop(key, None)
+                return CloseOutcome(
+                    "FLAT" if remaining == _ZERO else "STOP_FILLED",
+                    key,
+                    normalized_symbol,
+                    confirmed_remaining_quantity=remaining,
+                    broker_order_id=_order_id(raw),
+                )
+            if status not in _WORKING:
+                return CloseOutcome(
+                    "REJECTED",
+                    key,
+                    normalized_symbol,
+                    confirmed_remaining_quantity=remaining,
+                    protective_order_id=old_order_id,
+                    stop_price=current.stop_price if current is not None else None,
+                    detail=f"protective replacement ended {status}",
+                )
+            new_order_id = _order_id(raw) or old_order_id
+            confirmed_stop = _field(raw, "stop_price", default=candidate)
+            if isinstance(confirmed_stop, str):
+                confirmed_stop = Decimal(confirmed_stop)
+            price = _decimal(confirmed_stop, "confirmed stop_price", positive=True)
+            if current is not None and current.stop_price is not None:
+                price = max(price, current.stop_price)
+            self._protections[key] = _Protection(normalized_symbol, new_order_id, price)
+            await self._emit(
+                "PROTECTIVE_STOP_REPLACED",
+                position_id=key,
+                symbol=normalized_symbol,
+                order_id=new_order_id,
+                stop_price=price,
+                quantity=remaining,
+            )
+            return CloseOutcome(
+                "REPLACED",
+                key,
+                normalized_symbol,
+                confirmed_remaining_quantity=remaining,
+                protective_order_id=new_order_id,
+                stop_price=price,
+            )
+
+    async def detect_orphans(
+        self,
+        *,
+        local_intents: Iterable[object],
+        local_positions: Iterable[object] | Mapping[str, object],
+    ) -> tuple[OrphanOrder, ...]:
+        orders = await _resolve(self._broker.list_open_orders())
+        orphans = detect_orphan_orders(orders, local_intents, local_positions)
+        for orphan in orphans:
+            await self._emit(
+                "RECONCILIATION_DRIFT",
+                drift_type=orphan.reason,
+                broker_order_id=orphan.broker_order_id,
+                client_order_id=orphan.client_order_id,
+                symbol=orphan.symbol,
+                order_type=orphan.order_type,
+                position_quantity=orphan.position_quantity,
+            )
+        return orphans
+
+    async def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        """Stop accepting work.  Broker-held protective orders are left intact."""
+
+        self._closed = True
+        await self._emit("CLOSE_COORDINATOR_SHUTDOWN")
+
+    async def _close_locked(self, intent: SellIntent) -> CloseOutcome:
+        if intent.position_id in self._frozen:
+            return self._outcome(
+                "FROZEN",
+                intent,
+                reconciliation_required=True,
+                entries_blocked=True,
+                detail="position has an unresolved order outcome",
+            )
+        protection = self._protections.get(intent.position_id)
+        if intent.protective_order_id is not None:
+            if protection is None:
+                protection = _Protection(
+                    intent.symbol,
+                    intent.protective_order_id,
+                    intent.last_confirmed_stop_price,
+                )
+                self._protections[intent.position_id] = protection
+            elif protection.order_id != intent.protective_order_id:
+                return await self._freeze(
+                    intent.position_id,
+                    intent.symbol,
+                    "local protective order identity conflicts with close intent",
+                    intent=intent,
+                )
+
+        if intent.is_strategy and intent.minimum_hold > timedelta(0):
+            if intent.first_confirmed_entry_fill_at is None:
+                return self._outcome(
+                    "HOLD_BLOCKED",
+                    intent,
+                    detail="strategy exit has no confirmed entry fill time",
+                )
+            if self._now() < intent.first_confirmed_entry_fill_at + intent.minimum_hold:
+                return self._outcome(
+                    "HOLD_BLOCKED", intent, detail="minimum hold has not elapsed"
+                )
+
+        confirmed_before = await self._confirmed_quantity(intent.position_id, intent.symbol)
+        excluded = (
+            {protection.order_id}
+            if protection is not None and protection.order_id
+            else set()
+        )
+        already_committed = await self._working_sell_quantity(
+            intent.position_id, intent.symbol, exclude=excluded
+        )
+        available_before = max(_ZERO, confirmed_before - already_committed)
+        if intent.quantity > available_before:
+            await self._emit(
+                "SELL_REJECTED_OVERSIZE",
+                position_id=intent.position_id,
+                symbol=intent.symbol,
+                requested_quantity=intent.quantity,
+                confirmed_quantity=confirmed_before,
+                working_sell_quantity=already_committed,
+            )
+            return self._outcome(
+                "REJECTED",
+                intent,
+                remaining=confirmed_before,
+                detail="sell quantity exceeds broker-confirmed position minus working sells",
+            )
+        if confirmed_before == _ZERO:
+            self._protections.pop(intent.position_id, None)
+            return self._outcome("FLAT", intent, remaining=_ZERO)
+
+        if protection is not None and protection.order_id is not None:
+            cancel = await self._cancel_and_confirm(protection.order_id)
+            if cancel is None or _status(cancel) == "UNKNOWN":
+                return await self._freeze(
+                    intent.position_id,
+                    intent.symbol,
+                    "protective stop cancellation is UNKNOWN",
+                    intent=intent,
+                )
+            self._protections[intent.position_id] = _Protection(
+                intent.symbol, None, protection.stop_price
+            )
+            await self._emit(
+                "PROTECTIVE_STOP_CANCEL_CONFIRMED",
+                position_id=intent.position_id,
+                symbol=intent.symbol,
+                order_id=protection.order_id,
+                final_status=_status(cancel),
+            )
+
+        # This second broker read is the critical race boundary.  Any stop fills
+        # observed during cancellation reduce (or eliminate) the exit order.
+        confirmed = await self._confirmed_quantity(intent.position_id, intent.symbol)
+        if confirmed == _ZERO:
+            self._protections.pop(intent.position_id, None)
+            await self._emit(
+                "POSITION_FLAT_DURING_STOP_CANCEL",
+                position_id=intent.position_id,
+                symbol=intent.symbol,
+            )
+            return self._outcome("FLAT", intent, remaining=_ZERO)
+        committed = await self._working_sell_quantity(intent.position_id, intent.symbol)
+        available = max(_ZERO, confirmed - committed)
+        quantity = min(intent.quantity, available)
+        if quantity == _ZERO:
+            return self._outcome(
+                "REJECTED",
+                intent,
+                remaining=confirmed,
+                detail="broker-confirmed quantity is fully committed to working sells",
+            )
+
+        try:
+            order = await _resolve(self._broker.submit_exit(intent, quantity))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return await self._recover_protection(
+                intent,
+                quantity,
+                protection,
+                f"exit submission failed: {type(exc).__name__}",
+            )
+        status = _status(order)
+        if status == "UNKNOWN" or not status:
+            return await self._freeze(
+                intent.position_id,
+                intent.symbol,
+                "exit submission outcome is UNKNOWN",
+                intent=intent,
+                submitted_quantity=quantity,
+            )
+        order_id = _order_id(order)
+        await self._emit(
+            "EXIT_SELL_SUBMITTED",
+            position_id=intent.position_id,
+            symbol=intent.symbol,
+            order_id=order_id,
+            quantity=quantity,
+            kind=intent.kind,
+        )
+        if status == "PARTIALLY_FILLED":
+            if order_id is None:
+                return await self._unprotected(
+                    intent, quantity, "partially filled exit has no broker order id"
+                )
+            canceled = await self._cancel_and_confirm(order_id)
+            if canceled is None or _status(canceled) == "UNKNOWN":
+                return await self._unprotected(
+                    intent, quantity, "partial exit remainder cancellation is UNKNOWN"
+                )
+            return await self._recover_protection(
+                intent, quantity, protection, "exit partially filled", broker_order_id=order_id
+            )
+        if status in {"REJECTED", "CANCELED", "CANCELLED", "EXPIRED"}:
+            return await self._recover_protection(
+                intent,
+                quantity,
+                protection,
+                f"exit ended {status}",
+                broker_order_id=order_id,
+            )
+        if status == "FILLED":
+            remaining = await self._confirmed_quantity(intent.position_id, intent.symbol)
+            if remaining == _ZERO:
+                self._protections.pop(intent.position_id, None)
+                return self._outcome(
+                    "FLAT", intent, submitted=quantity, remaining=_ZERO, broker_order_id=order_id
+                )
+            return await self._recover_protection(
+                intent,
+                quantity,
+                protection,
+                "exit filled but a broker position remains",
+                broker_order_id=order_id,
+            )
+        return self._outcome(
+            "SUBMITTED",
+            intent,
+            submitted=quantity,
+            remaining=confirmed,
+            broker_order_id=order_id,
+        )
+
+    async def _recover_protection(
+        self,
+        intent: SellIntent,
+        submitted: Decimal,
+        prior: _Protection | None,
+        detail: str,
+        *,
+        broker_order_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> CloseOutcome:
+        remaining = await self._confirmed_quantity(intent.position_id, intent.symbol)
+        if remaining == _ZERO:
+            self._protections.pop(intent.position_id, None)
+            return self._outcome(
+                "FLAT",
+                intent,
+                submitted=submitted,
+                remaining=_ZERO,
+                broker_order_id=broker_order_id,
+                detail=detail,
+            )
+        stop_price = prior.stop_price if prior is not None else intent.last_confirmed_stop_price
+        if stop_price is None:
+            return await self._unprotected(
+                intent, submitted, f"{detail}; no last confirmed stop price", remaining=remaining
+            )
+        working = await self._working_sell_quantity(intent.position_id, intent.symbol)
+        protectable = max(_ZERO, remaining - working)
+        if protectable != remaining:
+            return await self._unprotected(
+                intent,
+                submitted,
+                f"{detail}; working sell prevents non-overlapping re-protection",
+                remaining=remaining,
+            )
+        protection_client_id = f"{intent.client_order_id}-reprotect"
+        try:
+            order = await _resolve(
+                self._broker.submit_protective_stop(
+                    intent.position_id,
+                    intent.symbol,
+                    remaining,
+                    stop_price,
+                    protection_client_id,
+                )
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return await self._unprotected(
+                intent,
+                submitted,
+                f"{detail}; re-protection failed: {type(exc).__name__}",
+                remaining=remaining,
+            )
+        status = _status(order)
+        order_id = _order_id(order)
+        raw_stop = _field(order, "stop_price", default=stop_price)
+        if isinstance(raw_stop, str):
+            raw_stop = Decimal(raw_stop)
+        if status not in _WORKING or order_id is None:
+            return await self._unprotected(
+                intent,
+                submitted,
+                f"{detail}; re-protection ended {status or 'UNKNOWN'}",
+                remaining=remaining,
+            )
+        confirmed_stop = _decimal(raw_stop, "stop_price", positive=True)
+        if confirmed_stop < stop_price:
+            return await self._unprotected(
+                intent,
+                submitted,
+                f"{detail}; broker confirmed re-protection below last stop",
+                remaining=remaining,
+            )
+        self._protections[intent.position_id] = _Protection(
+            intent.symbol, order_id, confirmed_stop
+        )
+        await self._emit(
+            "PROTECTIVE_STOP_REESTABLISHED",
+            position_id=intent.position_id,
+            symbol=intent.symbol,
+            order_id=order_id,
+            quantity=remaining,
+            stop_price=confirmed_stop,
+            reason=detail,
+        )
+        return self._outcome(
+            "REPROTECTED",
+            intent,
+            submitted=submitted,
+            remaining=remaining,
+            broker_order_id=broker_order_id,
+            protective_order_id=order_id,
+            stop_price=confirmed_stop,
+            detail=detail,
+        )
+
+    async def _cancel_and_confirm(self, order_id: str) -> object | None:
+        try:
+            result = await _resolve(self._broker.cancel_order(order_id))
+        except Exception:
+            result = None
+        status = _status(result)
+        if status in _TERMINAL:
+            return result
+        try:
+            observed = await _resolve(self._broker.get_order(order_id))
+        except Exception:
+            return None
+        return observed if _status(observed) in _TERMINAL else None
+

# AGENTS.md

## Purpose

This repository is operated by an autonomous multi-agent system (abracapocus_2).
All agents must follow these rules when modifying the codebase.

---

## Core Principles

- Minimal blast radius: only modify what is required for the task
- Deterministic verification: all changes must be verifiable via code (tests, compile, scripts)
- No architecture drift: do not introduce new frameworks or major design changes unless explicitly required
- No unrelated refactors
- All changes must be reproducible from a clean clone

---

## Project Structure

- docs/ → design, plans, architecture constraints
- plans/ → master plans
- phases/ → phase definitions
- tasks/ → executable task documents
- backends/ → CLI backend adapters
- agents/ → specialist agents
- runtime/ → orchestration, routing, state
- reports/ → execution reports (DO NOT MODIFY MANUALLY)
- state/runtime_state.json → runtime state (DO NOT COMMIT)

---

## Task Execution Rules

- Always operate from a task document when available
- Respect:
  - selected_backend
  - verification_profile
  - acceptance_criteria
- If a task conflicts with architecture constraints or phase scope:
  - STOP and report conflict

---

## Backend Rules

- Backends must:
  - execute commands deterministically
  - capture stdout, stderr, exit_code
  - not silently fail
- Do not invent backend interfaces; use existing adapters
- Codex CLI, Aider, Gemini, Claude Code should be invoked through backends only

---

## Verification Rules

- Verification must be deterministic
- Preferred checks:
  - pytest
  - python -m py_compile
- Do not rely on model self-evaluation

---

## Execution Control Flow (PERMANENT ARCHITECTURAL RULE)

**HEURISTIC INFERENCE MUST NEVER PARTICIPATE IN ABRACAPOCUS EXECUTION CONTROL FLOW.**

Abracapocus must not determine execution success, failure, acceptance,
rejection, blocking, retry eligibility, phase progression, or completion from
heuristic inference. A heuristic is any conclusion that is *inferred* rather
than *directly established by an explicit executable contract or a concrete
runtime fact*.

Runtime status is derived ONLY from concrete, mechanically observable facts:

1. The backend process exit code. A backend that exits `0` (with no hard
   write-policy violation) is a successful execution.
2. Objectively observed hard write-policy violations (changed paths outside the
   declared allowed write paths).
3. Explicit operator-authored commands (task/phase verification the plan
   explicitly contains). Their raw results are reported, kept DISTINCT from
   backend execution status.
4. Objective orchestrator failures with direct evidence (backend could not
   launch, required document could not be parsed, subprocess infrastructure
   failed).

**Verification results are observational and must not rewrite backend execution
status.** A verifier returning non-zero must NEVER, by itself, turn a
successful backend execution into unverified, stop a phase, or trigger an
automatic rerun. Verification is the result of a command, not authority to
rewrite history.

**Execution control:** Task-local problems (non-zero exit, timeout,
write-policy violation, frame failure, backend launch failure) produce
acceptance status ``"unverified"`` with truthful evidence preserved. They
MUST NOT stop sibling tasks, later phases, or the plan. Only operator
cancellation (SIGINT/SIGTERM/dashboard cancel) may terminate a run
(acceptance status ``"interrupted"``). Dependencies are ordering constraints,
not acceptance gates — any terminal attempt outcome satisfies a dependency
edge. The status ``"failed"`` is banned from acceptance output.

Do NOT reintroduce -- under any name, feature flag, "advisory" wrapper, or
compatibility mode -- context completeness/sufficiency scoring, change or
architecture assessment used as a gate, intent/scope matching, reconciliation
gates, no-progress judgments, confidence/risk scores, model/LLM/reviewer
judgments over status, shadow/adaptive/secondary-verification gates, or
heuristic retry/failure-classification control flow. Failure classification may
only *summarize* an already-established concrete failure; it must never create
one. Retries are permitted only for explicitly defined mechanical backend
failures. Future agents must not add these systems back.

---

## Git Rules

- Do not commit:
  - runtime_state.json
  - reports/
  - logs/
  - virtual environments
- Do not modify .gitignore unless required by task
- Do not create excessive commits; prefer grouped logical commits

---

## Allowed Changes

- Implement task requirements
- Fix failing verification
- Update relevant tests
- Improve documentation tied to the task

---

## Forbidden Changes

- Changing architecture without explicit instruction
- Adding dependencies without justification
- Modifying unrelated files
- Deleting important files
- Bypassing verification

---

## Planning Rules

- Plans are multi-phase
- Completed sections are immutable
- Remaining sections may be updated
- Tasks must align with:
  - project brief
  - architecture constraints
  - active phase

---

## Reporting

- All executions must produce structured reports
- Reports must include:
  - changed files
  - verification results
  - assessment

---

## Behavior

- Do not ask unnecessary questions
- Do not stall execution
- Do not perform broad scans unless required
- Prefer direct action over analysis

---

## Priority Order

This ordering guides *implementation decisions* only. It does NOT make
verification an acceptance authority: verification results are observational
(see "Execution Control Flow"), and never override a concrete backend
execution result.

1. Architecture constraints
2. Task definition
3. Verification results (observational signal, not acceptance authority)
4. Plan guidance

If conflicts occur, follow this order.

"""Pure, broker-independent monotonic stepped trailing-stop ratchet (LONG only).

Nothing here performs I/O or touches a broker, clock, persistence layer, or
order: every function maps explicit inputs to a value.  The module only
*computes stop candidates*; a coordinator decides whether and how to replace a
live protective order.

Model
-----
* ``initial_state`` starts with ``high_watermark == ratchet_anchor ==
  entry_reference`` and ``candidate_stop = entry_reference - distance``.
* ``advance`` raises ``high_watermark`` to ``max(previous, observed_high)``,
  counts the complete favorable steps ``(high_watermark - ratchet_anchor) //
  step`` and moves the anchor up by exactly that many whole steps (a single
  jump may cross several steps).  The candidate stop is
  ``ratchet_anchor - distance``.  Sub-step highs do not reprice.
* The watermark, anchor and candidate stop never decrease; a lower observed
  high changes nothing.  ``steps_advanced`` is the number of whole steps taken
  by the most recent ``initial_state`` (0) / ``advance`` call, not a running
  total.
* ``should_replace`` floors the candidate to the broker tick grid via an
  injected rounder *before* comparing, and answers True only when the rounded
  candidate is strictly above the last confirmed stop.

Documented basis (design decision)
----------------------------------
PERCENT distances **and** PERCENT steps are both computed on the *entry
reference*, never on the moving high watermark or anchor:
``amount = entry_reference * pct / 100``.  The resulting USD amounts are
therefore constant for the life of the position, which keeps the ratchet
deterministic and replay-stable.

Validation: all prices and amounts must be finite ``Decimal`` values; ``float``
(and ``bool``/``int``) inputs are rejected with ``ValueError``.  The SHORT side
is an explicit capability boundary and raises ``NotImplementedError``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import StrEnum

from mike_trade.domain.trading import TimeInForce

__all__ = [
    "DistanceKind",
    "SteppedTrailingPolicy",
    "SteppedTrailingState",
    "RatchetResult",
    "initial_state",
    "advance",
    "should_replace",
]

_ZERO = Decimal("0")
_HUNDRED = Decimal("100")
_LONG = "LONG"
_SHORT = "SHORT"


class DistanceKind(StrEnum):
    USD = "USD"
    PERCENT = "PERCENT"


def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a Decimal, not {type(value).__name__}")
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite Decimal")
    if positive and value <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be > 0")
    return value


def _kind(value: object, name: str) -> DistanceKind:
    try:
        return DistanceKind(value)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be one of {[k.value for k in DistanceKind]}") from None


def _flag(value: object, name: str) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(value, bool):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a bool")
    return value


def _require_long(side: object) -> None:
    normalized = side.strip().upper() if isinstance(side, str) else side
    if normalized == _SHORT:
        raise NotImplementedError("SHORT-side stepped trailing is not supported")
    if normalized != _LONG:
        raise ValueError("side must be 'LONG'")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SteppedTrailingPolicy:
    """Immutable stepped-trailing configuration."""

    distance_kind: DistanceKind
    distance_value: Decimal
    step_kind: DistanceKind
    step_value: Decimal
    min_replace_interval: timedelta
    time_in_force: TimeInForce
    policy_revision: str
    requires_standalone_stop: bool = True
    requires_stop_replace: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self, "distance_kind", _kind(self.distance_kind, "distance_kind"))
        object.__setattr__(self, "step_kind", _kind(self.step_kind, "step_kind"))
        _decimal(self.distance_value, "distance_value", positive=True)
        _decimal(self.step_value, "step_value", positive=True)
        if not isinstance(self.min_replace_interval, timedelta) or self.min_replace_interval < timedelta(0):
            raise ValueError("min_replace_interval must be a timedelta >= 0")
        tif = self.time_in_force
        if isinstance(tif, str):
            try:
                tif = TimeInForce[tif.strip().upper()]
            except KeyError:
                raise ValueError("time_in_force must be a TimeInForce (DAY/GTC)") from None
        if not isinstance(tif, TimeInForce):
            raise ValueError("time_in_force must be a TimeInForce (DAY/GTC)")
        object.__setattr__(self, "time_in_force", tif)
        if not isinstance(self.policy_revision, str) or not self.policy_revision.strip():
            raise ValueError("policy_revision must be a non-empty string")
        object.__setattr__(self, "policy_revision", self.policy_revision.strip())
        _flag(self.requires_standalone_stop, "requires_standalone_stop")
        _flag(self.requires_stop_replace, "requires_stop_replace")

    def distance_amount(self, entry_reference: Decimal) -> Decimal:
        """Trailing distance in USD (percent is taken on the entry reference)."""

        return _amount(self.distance_kind, self.distance_value, entry_reference)

    def step_amount(self, entry_reference: Decimal) -> Decimal:
        """Step increment in USD (percent is taken on the entry reference)."""

        return _amount(self.step_kind, self.step_value, entry_reference)


def _amount(kind: DistanceKind, value: Decimal, entry_reference: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    if kind is DistanceKind.USD:
        return value
    return entry_reference * value / _HUNDRED


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SteppedTrailingState:
    """Ratchet state; also the result type returned by ``initial_state``/``advance``."""

    entry_reference: Decimal
    high_watermark: Decimal
    ratchet_anchor: Decimal
    candidate_stop: Decimal
    steps_advanced: int = 0

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in ("entry_reference", "high_watermark", "ratchet_anchor", "candidate_stop"):
            _decimal(getattr(self, name), name, positive=True)
        if isinstance(self.steps_advanced, bool) or not isinstance(self.steps_advanced, int):
            raise ValueError("steps_advanced must be an int")
        if self.steps_advanced < 0:
            raise ValueError("steps_advanced must be >= 0")
        if self.high_watermark < self.ratchet_anchor:
            raise ValueError("high_watermark must be >= ratchet_anchor")
        if self.candidate_stop >= self.ratchet_anchor:
            raise ValueError("candidate_stop must be below ratchet_anchor")


RatchetResult = SteppedTrailingState


def _check_policy(policy: object) -> SteppedTrailingPolicy:
    if not isinstance(policy, SteppedTrailingPolicy):
        raise ValueError("policy must be a SteppedTrailingPolicy")
    return policy


def initial_state(
    entry_reference: Decimal, policy: SteppedTrailingPolicy, *, side: str = _LONG
) -> SteppedTrailingState:
    """Initial stop is ``entry_reference - distance``; it must stay positive."""

    _require_long(side)
    policy = _check_policy(policy)
    entry = _decimal(entry_reference, "entry_reference", positive=True)
    stop = entry - policy.distance_amount(entry)
    if stop <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError("trailing distance must be smaller than entry_reference")
    return SteppedTrailingState(
        entry_reference=entry,
        high_watermark=entry,
        ratchet_anchor=entry,
        candidate_stop=stop,
        steps_advanced=0,
    )


def advance(
    state: SteppedTrailingState,
    observed_high: Decimal,
    policy: SteppedTrailingPolicy,
    *,
    side: str = _LONG,
) -> RatchetResult:
    """Fold an observed high into ``state``; the candidate stop never decreases."""

    _require_long(side)
    policy = _check_policy(policy)
    if not isinstance(state, SteppedTrailingState):
        raise ValueError("state must be a SteppedTrailingState")
    high = _decimal(observed_high, "observed_high", positive=True)
    entry = state.entry_reference
    watermark = max(state.high_watermark, high)
    step = policy.step_amount(entry)
    steps = int((watermark - state.ratchet_anchor) // step)
    anchor = state.ratchet_anchor + step * steps
    # max() keeps the stop monotonic even if the caller swapped in a policy
    # with a wider distance between calls.
    stop = max(state.candidate_stop, anchor - policy.distance_amount(entry))
    return SteppedTrailingState(
        entry_reference=entry,
        high_watermark=watermark,
        ratchet_anchor=anchor,
        candidate_stop=stop,
        steps_advanced=steps,
    )


def should_replace(
    candidate_stop: Decimal,
    last_confirmed_stop: Decimal,
    tick_rounder: Callable[[Decimal], Decimal],
) -> bool:
    """True only if the tick-rounded candidate is strictly above the last confirmed stop.

    ``tick_rounder`` must round DOWN to a valid price increment; a rounder that
    returns a value above the candidate is rejected so a long stop is never
    raised past the computed level.
    """

    candidate = _decimal(candidate_stop, "candidate_stop", positive=True)
    confirmed = _decimal(last_confirmed_stop, "last_confirmed_stop", positive=True)
    if not callable(tick_rounder):
        raise ValueError("tick_rounder must be callable")
    rounded = _decimal(tick_rounder(candidate), "rounded candidate_stop")

        if not isinstance(min_replace_interval, timedelta) or min_replace_interval < timedelta(0):

            getattr(intent_recorder, "record_replacement_intent", None)
        ):
            raise TypeError("intent_recorder must be callable or expose record_replacement_intent")
        self._port = port
        self._intent_recorder = intent_recorder
        self._min_replace_interval = min_replace_interval
        self._clock = clock or (lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
        self._pending: dict[str, _Pending] = {}
        self._held: dict[str, _Held] = {}

        last_confirmed_stop: Decimal,

        client_order_id: str,

        """Request one replacement, returning no effective change without confirmation."""

        order_id = _text(protected_order_id, "protected_order_id")
        client_id = _text(client_order_id, "client_order_id")
        key = _text(position_id, "position_id") if position_id is not None else order_id
        candidate = _decimal(candidate_stop, "candidate_stop", positive=True)
        confirmed = _decimal(last_confirmed_stop, "last_confirmed_stop", positive=True)
        quantity = _decimal(qty, "qty", positive=True)
        resolved_tif = self._tif(tif)
        now = self._now()

        capability_error = self._capability_error(quantity, resolved_tif)
        if capability_error is not None:
            return self._local(
                ReplacementStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
                order_id,
                confirmed,
                quantity,
                now,
                capability_error,

class OrderIntent:

    execution_mode: AccountEnvironment
    account_key: str
    symbol: str

    purpose: OrderPurpose
    position_cycle_id: str
    order_type: OrderType
    time_in_force: TimeInForce
    signal_bar_time: datetime
    signal_expires_at: datetime
    quote_reference_time: datetime

    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for field in ("intent_id", "account_key", "position_cycle_id", "client_order_id"):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _text(getattr(self, field), field))
        symbol = _text(self.symbol, "symbol").upper()
        if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
            raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)

        if not isinstance(self.execution_mode, AccountEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("execution_mode must be an AccountEnvironment")
        if self.execution_mode not in {
            AccountEnvironment.SHADOW,
            AccountEnvironment.PAPER,
            AccountEnvironment.LIVE,
        }:
            raise ValueError("execution_mode must be SHADOW, PAPER, or LIVE")
        if not isinstance(self.side, OrderSide):
            raise TypeError("side must be an OrderSide")
        if not isinstance(self.purpose, OrderPurpose):
            raise TypeError("purpose must be an OrderPurpose")
        if not isinstance(self.order_type, OrderType):
            raise TypeError("order_type must be an OrderType")
        if not isinstance(self.time_in_force, TimeInForce):
            raise TypeError("time_in_force must be a TimeInForce")
        if isinstance(self.attempt_number, bool) or not isinstance(self.attempt_number, int):
            raise TypeError("attempt_number must be int")
        if self.attempt_number < 0:
            raise ValueError("attempt_number must be >= 0")

        for field in (
            "signal_bar_time",
            "signal_expires_at",
            "quote_reference_time",
            "created_at",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _utc(getattr(self, field), field))
        if self.signal_expires_at < self.signal_bar_time:
            raise ValueError("signal_expires_at must not precede signal_bar_time")

            object.__setattr__(
                self,

            )

        for field in (
            "qty",
            "notional",
            "limit_price",
            "stop_price",
            "trail_price",
            "trail_percent",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _positive_decimal(getattr(self, field), field))
        if (self.qty is None) == (self.notional is None):
            raise ValueError("exactly one of qty or notional is required")
        self._validate_prices()

        required_side = OrderSide.BUY if self.purpose is OrderPurpose.ENTRY_LONG else OrderSide.SELL
        if self.side is not required_side:
            if self.purpose is OrderPurpose.ENTRY_LONG:
                raise ValueError("short-opening sides are disabled; ENTRY_LONG requires BUY")
            raise ValueError(f"{self.purpose.value} is a long exit and requires SELL")

    def account_scope_id(self) -> str:

        return f"{self.execution_mode.value.lower()}:{self.account_key}"

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, **values: Any) -> OrderIntent:
        """Build an intent using the existing stable client-order-ID helper.

        Callers may still invoke the normal constructor when a provider-neutral
        externally allocated ID is already durable.
        """
        if "client_order_id" in values:
            raise TypeError("create() derives client_order_id; do not pass it")
        try:
            mode = values["execution_mode"]
            account_key = values["account_key"]
            cycle_id = values["position_cycle_id"]
            purpose = values["purpose"]
            attempt = values["attempt_number"]
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise TypeError(f"create() missing required argument: {exc.args[0]}") from None
        if not isinstance(purpose, OrderPurpose):
            raise TypeError("purpose must be an OrderPurpose")
        # This is intentionally lazy: the intent model and durable store stay
        # usable without importing a concrete broker adapter.
        from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import OrderPurpose as AlpacaOrderPurpose
        from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import make_client_order_id

        alpaca_purpose = {
            OrderPurpose.ENTRY_LONG: AlpacaOrderPurpose.ENTRY,
            OrderPurpose.EXIT_LONG: AlpacaOrderPurpose.EXIT,
            OrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP: AlpacaOrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP,
            OrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP: AlpacaOrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP,
            OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE: AlpacaOrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE,
            OrderPurpose.SAFETY_EXIT: AlpacaOrderPurpose.SAFETY_EXIT,
        }[purpose]
        values["client_order_id"] = make_client_order_id(
            mode, account_key, cycle_id, alpaca_purpose, attempt

        return cls(**values)

    def _validate_prices(self) -> None:
        if self.order_type in {OrderType.LIMIT, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
            if self.limit_price is None:

    """An idempotent, broker-neutral instruction to submit one order."""

    intent_id: str
    client_order_id: str
    account_scope_id: str
    cycle_id: str
    symbol: str
    side: OrderSide
    purpose: OrderPurpose
    order_type: OrderType
    time_in_force: TimeInForce
    created_at: datetime
    quantity: Decimal | None = None
    notional: Decimal | None = None
    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
    signal_id: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for field in ("intent_id", "client_order_id", "account_scope_id", "cycle_id"):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _require_text(getattr(self, field), field=field))
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol))
        _require_enum(self.side, OrderSide, field="side")
        _require_enum(self.purpose, OrderPurpose, field="purpose")
        _require_enum(self.order_type, OrderType, field="order_type")
        _require_enum(self.time_in_force, TimeInForce, field="time_in_force")
        object.__setattr__(self, "created_at", _require_utc(self.created_at, field="created_at"))

        quantity = _optional_decimal(
            self.quantity, field="quantity", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        notional = _optional_decimal(
            self.notional, field="notional", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        if (quantity is None) == (notional is None):
            raise ValueError("exactly one of quantity or notional is required")
        object.__setattr__(self, "quantity", quantity)
        object.__setattr__(self, "notional", notional)

        for field in ("limit_price", "stop_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent"):
            object.__setattr__(
                self,
                field,
                _optional_decimal(
                    getattr(self, field), field=field, minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
                ),
            )
        _validate_order_prices(
            self.order_type,
            self.limit_price,
            self.stop_price,
            self.trail_price,
            self.trail_percent,
        )
        if self.signal_id is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self, "signal_id", _require_text(self.signal_id, field="signal_id")
            )
        if self.side is OrderSide.SELL and self.purpose is OrderPurpose.ENTRY:
            raise ValueError("short entry intents are not supported")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BrokerOrder:
    """A normalized broker order snapshot."""

    broker_order_id: str
    client_order_id: str
    account_scope_id: str
    symbol: str
    side: OrderSide
    order_type: OrderType
    status: BrokerOrderStatus
    quantity: Decimal
    filled_quantity: Decimal
    submitted_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    filled_avg_price: Decimal | None = None
    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
    replaced_by: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for field in ("broker_order_id", "client_order_id", "account_scope_id"):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _require_text(getattr(self, field), field=field))
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol))
        _require_enum(self.side, OrderSide, field="side")
        _require_enum(self.order_type, OrderType, field="order_type")
        _require_enum(self.status, BrokerOrderStatus, field="status")
        quantity = _require_decimal(
            self.quantity, field="quantity", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
        )
        filled = _require_decimal(self.filled_quantity, field="filled_quantity")
        if filled > quantity:
            raise ValueError("filled_quantity must not exceed quantity")
        object.__setattr__(self, "quantity", quantity)
        object.__setattr__(self, "filled_quantity", filled)
        average = _optional_decimal(
            self.filled_avg_price,
            field="filled_avg_price",
            minimum=_ZERO,
            inclusive=False,
        )
        if filled > _ZERO and average is None:
            raise ValueError("filled_avg_price is required when filled_quantity is positive")
        object.__setattr__(self, "filled_avg_price", average)
        for field in ("limit_price", "stop_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent"):
            object.__setattr__(
                self,
                field,
                _optional_decimal(
                    getattr(self, field), field=field, minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
                ),
            )
        _validate_order_prices(
            self.order_type,
            self.limit_price,
            self.stop_price,
            self.trail_price,
            self.trail_percent,
        )
        submitted = _require_utc(self.submitted_at, field="submitted_at")
        updated = _require_utc(self.updated_at, field="updated_at")
        if updated < submitted:
            raise ValueError("updated_at must not be before submitted_at")
        object.__setattr__(self, "submitted_at", submitted)
        object.__setattr__(self, "updated_at", updated)
        if self.replaced_by is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self, "replaced_by", _require_text(self.replaced_by, field="replaced_by")
            )

    @property
    def is_terminal(self) -> bool:
        return self.status in TERMINAL_ORDER_STATUSES

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PositionCycle:
    """A single long entry followed by a single complete discretionary exit."""

    cycle_id: str
    account_scope_id: str
    symbol: str
    direction: PositionDirection = PositionDirection.LONG
    state: PositionCycleState = PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY
    entry_strategy_key: str | None = None
    entry_fills: tuple[Fill, ...] = ()
    exit_fills: tuple[Fill, ...] = ()
    opened_at: datetime | None = None
    closed_at: datetime | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for field in ("cycle_id", "account_scope_id"):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _require_text(getattr(self, field), field=field))
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol))
        _require_enum(self.direction, PositionDirection, field="direction")
        if self.direction is not PositionDirection.LONG:
            raise ValueError("SHORT position cycles are dormant")
        _require_enum(self.state, PositionCycleState, field="state")
        if self.entry_strategy_key is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self,
                "entry_strategy_key",
                _require_text(self.entry_strategy_key, field="entry_strategy_key"),
            )
        if not isinstance(self.entry_fills, tuple) or not isinstance(self.exit_fills, tuple):
            raise ValueError("entry_fills and exit_fills must be tuples")

        all_fills = self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills
        if any(not isinstance(fill, Fill) for fill in all_fills):
            raise ValueError("cycle fills must be Fill instances")
        fill_ids = [fill.fill_id for fill in all_fills]
        if len(fill_ids) != len(set(fill_ids)):
            raise ValueError("fill_id values must be unique within a cycle")
        for fill in all_fills:
            if fill.account_scope_id != self.account_scope_id or fill.symbol != self.symbol:
                raise ValueError("fill account_scope_id and symbol must match the cycle")
        if any(fill.side is not OrderSide.BUY for fill in self.entry_fills):
            raise ValueError("entry fills must have BUY side")
        if any(fill.side is not OrderSide.SELL for fill in self.exit_fills):
            raise ValueError("exit fills must have SELL side")
        if self.exit_quantity > self.entry_quantity:
            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")

        opened_at = _optional_utc(self.opened_at, field="opened_at")
        closed_at = _optional_utc(self.closed_at, field="closed_at")
        object.__setattr__(self, "opened_at", opened_at)
        object.__setattr__(self, "closed_at", closed_at)
        if opened_at is not None and closed_at is not None and closed_at < opened_at:
            raise ValueError("closed_at must not be before opened_at")

        if self.state is PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY:
            if all_fills or opened_at is not None or closed_at is not None:
                raise ValueError("PENDING_ENTRY cycles cannot contain fills or lifecycle times")
        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.OPEN:
            if (
                not self.entry_fills
                or self.exit_fills
                or opened_at is None
                or closed_at is not None
            ):
                raise ValueError("OPEN cycles require entry fills only and opened_at")
        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.EXITING:
            if not self.entry_fills or self.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
                raise ValueError("EXITING cycles require a positive remaining quantity")
            if opened_at is None or closed_at is not None:
                raise ValueError("EXITING cycles require opened_at and no closed_at")
        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.CLOSED:
            if not self.entry_fills or self.remaining_quantity != _ZERO:
                raise ValueError("CLOSED cycles require a fully exited entry")
            if opened_at is None or closed_at is None:
                raise ValueError("CLOSED cycles require opened_at and closed_at")
        elif closed_at is not None and opened_at is None:
            raise ValueError("an ABANDONED cycle cannot close before it opens")

    def apply_entry_fill(self, fill: Fill) -> PositionCycle:
        if not isinstance(fill, Fill):
            raise ValueError("fill must be Fill")
        if self.state not in {PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY, PositionCycleState.OPEN}:
            raise ValueError("entry fills are allowed only before exit begins")
        if self.exit_fills:
            raise ValueError("entry fills are not allowed after an exit fill")
        if fill.side is not OrderSide.BUY:
            raise ValueError("entry fill side must be BUY")
        if fill.fill_id in {item.fill_id for item in self.entry_fills}:
            raise ValueError("fill_id already exists in cycle")
        opened_at = self.opened_at if self.opened_at is not None else fill.filled_at
        return replace(
            self,
            state=PositionCycleState.OPEN,
            entry_fills=self.entry_fills + (fill,),
            opened_at=opened_at,
        )

    def begin_exit(self) -> PositionCycle:
        if self.state is not PositionCycleState.OPEN or self.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
            raise ValueError("exit can begin only for an OPEN cycle with remaining quantity")
        return replace(self, state=PositionCycleState.EXITING)

    def apply_exit_fill(self, fill: Fill) -> PositionCycle:
        if not isinstance(fill, Fill):
            raise ValueError("fill must be Fill")
        if self.state is not PositionCycleState.EXITING:
            raise ValueError("exit fills require an EXITING cycle")
        if fill.side is not OrderSide.SELL:
            raise ValueError("exit fill side must be SELL")
        if fill.fill_id in {item.fill_id for item in self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills}:
            raise ValueError("fill_id already exists in cycle")
        if fill.quantity > self.remaining_quantity:
            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")
        fills = self.exit_fills + (fill,)
        if fill.quantity == self.remaining_quantity:
            return replace(
                self,
                state=PositionCycleState.CLOSED,
                exit_fills=fills,
                closed_at=fill.filled_at,
            )
        return replace(self, exit_fills=fills)
"""Fail-closed startup reconciliation for one broker account or scenario.

The operational schema predates :mod:`mike_trade.portfolio.cycles`: its
``position_cycles.state`` column cannot represent ``RECONCILING`` or
``UNMANAGED``, and it has no first-class cancel/replacement-intent tables.
Consequently this module exposes those states in :class:`ReconciliationReport`
and durably records discrepancies in the existing reconciliation journal.  It
derives pending cancels/replacements from broker-order status.  Callers needing
provider-specific intent queues can supply them through the broker port without
changing the database schema.

One instance is permanently bound to one ``ScopedWriter`` and one broker
environment.  Every query is qualified by that writer's scope; snapshots from
another account, mode, or scenario are rejected before they can be persisted.
"""

_TERMINAL = frozenset(
    {
        BrokerOrderStatus.FILLED,
